settings.text: New Breakthrough Removes Plaque & Heals Gums On A Molecular Level

settings.repere: Paragraphe · After 11+ years of research and 26 resea
settings.text: After 11+ years of research and 26 research studies, scientists discover this groundbreaking L-1220 compound that removes plaque 250% better and improves gum health 190% more than traditional toothpaste.
Heals Gum On a molecular level

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Causing waves throughout the oral care i
settings.text: Causing waves throughout the oral care industry, L-1220 is being used in LIVFRESH®, which has been featured by all major media outlets, including NBC, FOX, WSJ, GQ, and ABC. Using 100% edible ingredients, LIVFRESH repels bacteria off the tooth surface and forms a protective barrier around your tooth preventing new plaque from forming. Formulated as a gel toothpaste, it uses “Activated Edathamil” to help reduce oxidative stress by fighting off Free Radicals, which are unstable molecules that can harm your health on a cellular level.
